feed_LiOH_wt_frac.note: No public value for Tesla/Veolia crystallizer feed found yet

tesla_robstown.text: Robstown, TX refinery, operational in 2026; spodumene -> kiln/cooler -> alkaline leach -> purification -> crystallization -> battery-grade LiOH; aims to make enough LiOH for about 50 GWh/yr of batteries

veolia_china.text: Veolia MVR-driven crystallizers at a Chinese spodumene-to-LiOH plant; two-stage crystallization to battery grade

mvr_market_share.text: MVR about 55-60% of the industrial evaporator/crystallizer market (2026)

problems.text: Alkaline LiOH liquor foams, carrying LiOH into the condensate
Li2CO3 scales evaporator heat-transfer surfaces (retrograde solubility)
